data.title: 轻井泽惠 · 晨光卫衣下的慵懒甜笑
data.description: 假日清晨明亮的阳光漫过床头柜，惠只穿着一件宽大松垮的深色连帽卫衣，衣领歪斜滑落，露出大片白皙细腻的香肩与精致锁骨。亚麻色长发蓬松散乱，她慵懒地盘腿坐在纯白床铺上，双手拉着过长的袖口捂在嘴边偷笑，双眼弯成了月牙，洋溢着被全然宠溺包裹的无尽幸福。
data.location: warm morning bedroom with rumpled white duvet
data.action: sitting cross-legged on white bed in oversized dark hoodie slipping off shoulder, long sleeves covering hands, tousled wavy blonde hair, bare legs, giggling behind sleeves with rosy cheeks
data.lighting: bright morning sunbeams filling the entire bedroom with cheerful warmth
data.mood: pampered girlfriend bliss, effortlessly cute domestic intimacy
data.promptProse: Sitting cross-legged on a sunny bed in an oversized boyfriend hoodie slipping off one shoulder, Kei giggles behind extra-long sleeves. Her bare legs and tousled blonde hair glow warmly in the morning sun.
data.animaCaption: Kei sitting on a sunlit bed in an oversized hoodie with bare shoulders, giggling cutely.
